D5/S3/Arith/GoldenPell.pell_form_eq_four.name: D5.S3.Arith.GoldenPell.pell_form_eq_four_mul_norm
D5/S3/Arith/GoldenPell.pell_form_eq_four.signature: theorem pell_form_eq_four_mul_norm (g : GoldenInt) : (2 * g.a + g.b) ^ 2 - 5 * g.b ^ 2 = 4 * norm g

D5/S3/Arith/GoldenPell.pell_pm_four_iff_.name: D5.S3.Arith.GoldenPell.pell_pm_four_iff_signed_lucas_fib
D5/S3/Arith/GoldenPell.pell_pm_four_iff_.signature: theorem pell_pm_four_iff_signed_lucas_fib (x y : ℤ) : (x ^ 2 - 5 * y ^ 2 = 4 ∨ x ^ 2 - 5 * y ^ 2 = -4) ↔ ∃ (s : Bool) (n : ℤ), x = signedInt s (goldenLucasZ n) ∧ y = signedInt s (Int.fib n)
